judgement.reason: OpenClaw keeps its state, memory and credentials on local disk, and Deployz has only stateless containers with no persistent volumes, but the shown lines do not prove that a supported datastore cannot replace that storage.

evidence.quote: State, memory, and credentials live on your hardware.
The [Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway) is the local control plane for sessions, tools, events, and channel connections.
